item.tib: drag po khyung gis dbang chog sde brgyad dbang sdud
item.coloph: de ltar drag po khyung gi bsgrub (sgrub) pa'i/ dbang byang sde brgyad dbang sdud 'di/ khyad par gza' gdon byung dang klu nad rigs/ khyad par gnyan nad can laM mngag pa yin/ slob dpon chen po pad ma thod phreng gis/ man ngag dam pa'i bcud phyung khyung bsgrubs ( sgrab) la/ dbang gis (gi) dam pa man ngag snying po 'di/ phyi rab (rabs) don du skal ldan khyod la gtad/ shin tu man ngag zab bo gsang rgya thob/ gar thod thod la bstan na bka' chad 'beb/ de phyir gsang sbas thabs la mkhas par gyis/ de ltar drag po khyung gis (gi) dbang byang 'di/ slob dpon pad ma thod phrengs kyis (phreng gis/)nges med sprang po bdag la snyan du rgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge gtab (btab) pa 'di/ yid dam dbal khyung nyid la mthol lo bshags/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol/ bka' skyongs srung ma'i (mas) bka' chad ma btang (gtong) zhig dge ba 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob par shog/
